title: pelargonium hispidum
intro: Pelargonium hispidum, commonly known as the 'Dune Geranium', is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and respiratory infections. The health benefits of Pelargonium hispidum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can help soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which work together to provide relief from symptoms and promote overall well-being.
